parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, facility ban, border friction or police targeting of trans visitors is documented, and discrimination law covering goods/services/health and hate-crime enhancements exist on paper. However severity if outed is driven by documented public hostility: continued political hate speech (222+ online incidents in 2023), threats and several physical attacks on a gender-nonconforming TV psychologist, Pride cancellation after attacks and rock-throwing requiring 2,000 police. Recourse is thin: prosecutors use misdemeanour charges where hate-crime proceedings are warranted, limiting deterrence, with no documented successful traveller remedy or prosecution. Restrictive legal-gender regime is only a climate signal, not a visitor deduction. No documented social acceptance or working visitor-facing protection offsets hostility, placing this in elevated, not reduced, risk.
